02 // ARCHITECTURE

SAPPHIRE CRYSTAL & FLUTED DIAL

Double-domed anti-reflective sapphire crystal protecting the high-precision fluted guilloche dial, moonphase complication at 12 o'clock, and date window at 3 o'clock.

  • Hardness: 9 Mohs (Sapphire Crystal)
  • Luminescence: Super-LumiNova BGW9
  • Water Resistance: 5 ATM (50 Meters)

EXPLODED CALIBRE ARCHITECTURE

Over 180 micro-engineered components in synchronous harmony. The 8-screw bezel, dial plate, tourbillon bridge, mainplate, and oscillating rotor separate in 3D space.

1. Sapphire Crystal Double-domed anti-glare
2. 8-Screw Bezel 316L Stainless Steel

4. Open Tourbillon Gold cage & ruby pivot
5. Mainplate & Rubies Precision gear train
6. Oscillating Weight Automatic winding rotor
